mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the monetary policy stance becomes more accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% signals labor market weakness, which typically precedes economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 240, SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO is above its 1-year moving average, SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1,100,000 units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1100.0, SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payrolls (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises in the same month, SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer spending regimes (RSAFS > 450,000 million dollars), retail sales growth supports corporate revenue and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS > 450000.0, SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances (Rank IC < 0.03).
